headline.purpose: Page title on dashboard and settings; the largest size in the product.

title.purpose: Panel and empty-state headings, pane-header project name, brand label.

body.purpose: Running text and comments; 1.7 line height for Han text.

fact.purpose: Every measured value: times, versions, counts, ids, sizes, the status bar.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, the focus-mode toolbar and its restore button.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The artifact frame on the stage only.

shadows.name: selected-row-marker
shadows.purpose: The coral marker inside the selected catalog row.

shadows.name: stage-light
shadows.value: radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% -10%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9), transparent 70%) / night: radial-gradient(110% 60% at 50% -12%, rgb(255 236 220 / 0.11), transparent 72%)
shadows.purpose: The lamp: light falling onto the stage from above. Background, not a shadow; the only gradient on the bench.

motion.name: dur-micro
motion.purpose: Colour and fill changes on hover.

motion.name: dur-long
motion.purpose: The longest allowed transition (panel and drawer moves).

themes.note: Frontmatter keys prefixed night- are the .dark values of the same roles.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled coral action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Geist Variable', 'PingFang TC', system-ui, sans-serif); height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 6px); background: var(--color-accent, #b0471f); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #fff); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--dur-short, 200ms) var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), transform var(--dur-short, 200ms) var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent, #b0471f), var(--color-ink, #18181a) 14%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #b0471f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M4 4h16v12H8l-4 4z"/></svg>留言</button>

components.name: Underline Tabs
components.description: Inspector and settings tabs in the 48px header row; coral underline on the active tab, blue mono counts.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e2e2df); background: var(--color-paper, #f5f5f4); } .ds-tab { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Geist Variable', 'PingFang TC', system-ui, sans-serif); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 48px; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 2px 6px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #66666c); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color var(--dur-micro, 120ms) var(--ease-out, ease-out); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #18181a); } .ds-tab[data-active=true] { border-bottom-color: var(--color-accent, #b0471f); color: var(--color-ink, #18181a); } .ds-tab span { font-family: var(--font-outlier, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); color: var(--color-cool, #3560d4); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #b0471f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Catalog Row
components.description: The row under the lamp: neutral fill and a 2px coral inset marker when selected.
components.css: .ds-list { width: 300px; background: var(--color-paper, #f5f5f4); border-right: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e2e2df); } .ds-row { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Geist Variable', 'PingFang TC', system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; gap: 5px; width: 100%; min-height: 68px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e2e2df); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #18181a); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--color-hover, #ebebe9); } .ds-row[data-selected=true] { background: var(--color-hover, #ebebe9); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--color-accent, #b0471f); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #b0471f); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-row__name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-row__meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--color-muted, #66666c); font-size: 12px; } .ds-row__meta time { font-family: var(--font-outlier, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); color: var(--color-cool, #3560d4); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; }

components.name: Stage and Sheet
components.description: The preview: stage under the lamp gradient, artifact on a white sheet, 28px mono status bar.
components.css: .ds-stage { height: 180px; padding: 16px 20px 0; background: var(--stage-light, radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% -10%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9), transparent 70%)), var(--color-stage, #e9e9e7); } .ds-sheet { height: 100%; background: var(--color-sheet, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e2e2df); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ink, #18181a) 4%, transparent), 0 18px 48px -18px var(--color-overlay-shadow, rgb(24 24 26 / 0.14)); } .ds-status { font-family: var(--font-outlier, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e2e2df); background: var(--color-paper, #f5f5f4); color: var(--color-muted, #66666c); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--color-paper-2, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e2e2df); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 8px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay, 0 12px 32px -8px rgb(24 24 26 / 0.14), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(24 24 26 / 0.14)); } .ds-dock__btn { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Geist Variable', 'PingFang TC', system-ui, sans-serif); height: 32px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-2, #3b3b40); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dock__btn:hover { background: var(--color-hover, #ebebe9); color: var(--color-ink, #18181a); } .ds-dock__btn[data-active=true] { background: var(--color-accent-soft, #f8e6de); color: var(--color-accent, #b0471f); } .ds-dock__btn span { font-family: var(--font-outlier, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); color: var(--color-cool, #3560d4); font-size: 12px; } .ds-dock__btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #b0471f); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The application is one workbench, and only the work under the lamp is lit: the artifact being read and the row being worked on. Everything else is the bench itself, a neutral near-black (or, by day, an off-white) laid out in a few tonal steps and divided by hairline rules. The third-party artifact sits on a dimmer stage like a white sheet under a soft pool of light; the interface frames it and never restyles it.

Density is that of a desk tool used for long sessions on a large display. Panes meet at 1px seams rather than floating as cards; every screen shares the same 48px header row, the same text-button toolbar, the same underline tabs and the same status-bar height. The workspace, focus mode, the dashboard and settings read as one tool. Colour carries meaning, not decoration: coral is the person, blue is the machine.

This world replaced the earlier Console system; nothing of that system carries over.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral bench in four steps (ground, raised, sunk, hover) plus a separate stage, with no warm or cool cast.
Two signals only: coral for the person, the selection and the one primary action; blue for agents, times, versions and counts.
Geist for words, Geist Mono for every measured fact.
Flat panes joined by 1px rules; the only shadows belong to things that float over the bench.
Daylight and night are the same bench under different light; both themes are required.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Coral means a person or a choice; blue means a machine or a measurement. Never swap them, never add a third signal colour, never use either as decoration.

rules.name: The One Coral Fill Rule
rules.body: One filled coral button per screen. On the comments tab that is the send-all dispatch at the head of the panel. Everything else in a toolbar is a text button.

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: Light falls only on the stage: a radial gradient from above (`--stage-light`) over the stage colour, and the artifact sheet beneath it. Nothing else on the bench gets a gradient or glow.

rules.name: The Measured Fact Rule
rules.body: Anything measured (a time, version, count, id, size) is set in Geist Mono with tabular numerals, and in instrument blue when it is the subject of the line.

rules.name: The Han Leading Rule
rules.body: Under `:lang(zh)` headings drop negative tracking and running text opens to 1.7 line height.

rules.name: The Seams Not Cards Rule
rules.body: Panes meet at 1px seams; a pane never gets a shadow or a floating card treatment. Shadows are for overlays and the sheet only.

dos: Do take every colour from `tokens.css` through its role (`--color-accent`, `--color-cool`, `--color-paper-*`), and define both the daylight and night value of any new token.
Do keep coral for the person, the selection and the one primary action, and blue for agents, times, versions and counts.
Do set every measured fact in Geist Mono with tabular numerals.
Do open every screen with the 48px header row and the brand mark in the same place, and close panes with the 28px status row.
Do use ghost text buttons in toolbars and the 2px coral underline for the active tab.
Do mark the selected row with the neutral hover fill and the 2px coral inset marker.
Do keep transitions short (120ms for colour, 200ms for state, 380ms at most) on the shared ease-out curve, and honour reduced motion.
Do self-host every font and set styles through CSS files or the CSSOM; the CSP allows `style-src 'self'` and `font-src 'self'` only.
donts: Don't add a second filled coral button to a screen, or fill a selected row with coral.
Don't add a permanent sidebar to Review; settings and dashboard share the one-column page shell.
Don't put shadows on panes, rows or resting panels; shadows belong to overlays and the artifact sheet.
Don't restyle or tint the artifact; it stays on its white sheet in both themes.
Don't load a CJK webfont or any font from a third-party host.
Don't introduce a third signal colour, a gradient outside the stage, or a type size outside 12, 13, 14, 16, 20, 24.
Don't ship a screen that works in only one of the two themes.
